notes.text: Available in cPanel & WHM 11 and later.

Evaluates raw Exim configuration syntax. cfgText can contain secrets and uses SensitiveParameter; even though upstream marks the operation read-only, this method uses form POST to keep text out of URLs. Omitted cfgText analyzes the installed configuration; with section, supply only that section text. Validation is distinct from eximConfigurationCheck(), which attempts repairs. Both invalid-configuration details and valid exim_caps fields are retained; dynamic directive names map to strict integer 0/1 flags. No configuration change, restart, retry or live syntax verification is established.

description: Server-wide mail authentication and DNS settings, incoming blocks, account outgoing-mail controls, mailbox and delivery diagnostics, mobile profiles, Exim and spamd configuration, and Greylisting. Mail, private-key, configuration and profile outputs can contain sensitive data. Mutations use form POST, including private-key export and raw Exim syntax validation. Per-domain failures remain separate from API status. No automatic delivery, expunge, retry or rollback is provided. Existing Greylisting service-state observations and exclusions remain unchanged.
